newsitem.title: JAMAICA: CRICKET-WEST INDIES WIN TOSS, OPT TO BAT V INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WEST INDIES WIN TOSS, OPT TO BAT V INDIA.

text.p: West Indies won the toss and opted to bat on the opening day of the first test in their five-match series against India at Sabina Park on Thursday.
West Indies included middle order batsman Roland Holder and fast bowler Franklyn Rose, both making their test debuts.
Holder, who has already played in 30 one-day internationals, replaces out-of-form batsman Jimmy Adams, while Rose was chosen as the fourth paceman ahead of uncapped leg-spinner Rawl Lewis.
India are unchanged from their only match ahead of the first test, against Jamaica, giving fast bowler Abey Kuruvilla his first cap.
West Indies - Sherwin Campbell, Stuart Williams, Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Brian Lara, Carl Hooper, Roland Holder, Junior Murray, Ian Bishop, Curtly Ambrose, Courtney Walsh (captain), Franklyn Rose.
India - V.V. Laxman, Navjot Sidhu, Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Mohammad Azharuddin, Rahul Dravid, Saurav Ganguly, Nayan Mongia, Sunil Joshi, Anil Kumble, Abey Kuruvilla, Venkatesh Prasad.
